upload_file_to_storage_backend: upload a file to a custom storage backend like Azure Blob Storage and create a file object with storage metadata
create_file_object_with_storage_metadata: create an OpenAIFileObject with storage backend metadata including storage_url and backend name in hidden params
create_unified_file_id: create a base64-encoded unified file ID for managed files with model mappings and file metadata
store_in_managed_files: store a file in the managed files system with a unified file ID and model-to-storage URL mappings
get_storage_backend: get a storage backend instance by name for uploading files to supported backends like Azure Blob Storage
